Basis for Intervening:
Environmental Law and Policy Center (ELPC) is a regional sustainable energy and environmental organization based in Chicago, Illinois with members, contributors, and offices throughout the Midwest. Among other things, ELPC advocates before the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, MISO, and state regulatory authorities for clean, reliable energy generation in order to reduce ratepayer costs and improve environmental outcomes. As part of this work, ELPC has been a participant in proceedings before the Commission and in MISO stakeholder processes. This proceeding raises issues which are important to the environmental, public health, reliability and affordability interests that ELPC seeks to advance. ELPC's interest in this proceeding is not adequately represented by any other party. Further, ELPC’s participation in this matter is in the public interest. For the foregoing reasons, ELPC respectfully request that the Commission grant this motion to intervene.
